name: Accordion, 8 panels + glue tab
blurb: Two strips joined with a glue tab and folded zig-zag. Every neighbouring panel is continuous: made for panoramas and long split pairs.

steps.text: Print on one side, scaling off.
Cut along the red lines: the top and bottom edge, between the strips, and the small scrap at the end of the bottom strip.
Fold every dashed line zig-zag: first one away from you, the next one towards you, alternating.
Fold the GLUE tab back along its line.
Put glue or double-sided tape on the tab. Stick it behind panel 5 so the strips become one long strip, 1 to 8.
Fold it closed. Panel 1 is the front, panel 8 the back.
